title: Precursor-driven Jahn–Teller distortion as a hidden origin of surface instability in Mn-stabilized Ni-rich cathodes
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6EE00713A, Paper
JinHa Shim, Young Geol Yu, Yu Bin Choi, Jin Ho Bang
Interfacial destabilization caused by a chemically unstable Jahn–Teller distorted Mn4−x–O coordination environment was observed for the first time in high-Ni cathodes due to surface Mn oxidation in the precursor stage.
